question: Why does YOLOX-M lose ~30 mAP under INT8 (Model Optimizer Q/DQ, entropy calibration, FP16 for non-quantized ops) on TensorRT 11.3, when YOLOX-S loses 0.6?
images: first N COCO val2017 images by id; AP = mAP@0.5:0.95

runs.variant: int8, fp16 elsewhere, head output convs not quantized
int8, fp32 graph converted to fp16 with onnxconverter-common instead
fp16 except compute nodes [0,182) in fp32
fp16 except compute nodes [182,364) in fp32
fp16 except single node 91 in fp32
fp16 except single node 182 in fp32
fp16 except single node 300 in fp32

ruled_out: my FP32-decode post-pass (raw Model Optimizer output scores the same)
Q/DQ scales stored in fp16 (max relative rounding error 0.26%, none flushed)
the head output convolutions (excluding them from INT8 changes nothing)
Model Optimizer's fp16 conversion (a different converter fails the same way)
a single bad tactic (a different builder optimisation level fails the same way)
conclusion: Fails only when the middle of the network (roughly compute nodes 91-273) is INT8+FP16 on both sides of node 182; any large FP32 region fixes it. Consistent with a TensorRT INT8+FP16 fusion problem rather than a numerical one. Not resolved; YOLOX-M ships as FP16, since INT8 with FP32 islands is accurate but no faster than FP16 (1.25 ms vs 1.25 ms in a 10 s trtexec run).
